env_allowlist.HOME: inherited only by the Python recipe; every Lean subprocess receives a fresh disposable HOME
env_allowlist.PATH: must contain the elan launcher used for relocatable Lean discovery
env_allowlist.STAGE1_LEAN_BIN: optional explicit pinned Lean executable override; its SHA-256 must match the receipt

recipes.network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs inside bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, a fresh disposable HOME, and only a fresh temporary output directory writable. The checker constructs LEAN_PATH from manifest-pinned packages' pre-existing warm build roots; only the three directly claimed source/olean boundaries are hash-checked, so the broader compiled closure remains an explicit release blocker. It invokes no update, build, clone, fetch, or dependency repair.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line UTF-8 gate summary bound by validation-receipt.json

recipes.scope_boundary: Network-isolated trust-zero fresh-output replay of the exact statement, two conditional composition declarations, and all 20 extant partial proof declarations. It covers zero frozen obligations and supplies no Kunneth inclusion, projection, exact sequence, Eilenberg-Zilber comparison, unconditional root proof, release hermeticity, or distinct-runner independence.

status_boundary: A passing recipe self-tests only a truthful blocked validation packet. It cannot promote the unfinished proof dependency, close a frozen obligation or root, establish M0/E0/E1, AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release, or master acceptance.
